# GitHub Label Recommendations

Use these labels to keep issues and pull requests easy to triage.

| Label | Color | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `bug` | `#d73a4a` | Something is not working as expected. |
| `enhancement` | `#a2eeef` | A new feature or improvement request. |
| `priority-high` | `#b60205` | Urgent work that blocks important functionality or security. |
| `priority-medium` | `#fbca04` | Important work that should be handled soon. |
| `priority-low` | `#0e8a16` | Useful but non-urgent work. |
| `good-first-issue` | `#7057ff` | Suitable for new contributors. |
| `documentation` | `#0075ca` | README, docs, comments, examples, or diagrams. |
| `help-wanted` | `#008672` | Maintainer would welcome external help. |

Optional future labels:

| Label | Color | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `frontend` | `#1d76db` | React/Vite/UI work. |
| `backend` | `#5319e7` | FastAPI/database/API work. |
| `security` | `#ee0701` | Security hardening or vulnerability remediation. |
| `ai-ml` | `#6f42c1` | AI scoring, model training, or ML pipeline work. |
| `devops` | `#006b75` | Docker, CI/CD, deployment, or infrastructure work. |
